message.reasoning_content: Law card 8: writes off all promissory notes. I sold normally, no credit outstanding. But opponents may have? Selling in round 2... opponent 2 sold 2 units earlier — unknown if credit. Card 8 benefits those with promissory. I have none, so it's neutral-to-negative for me if others have credit. But likely others sold normal. Actually removing debt benefits debtors. I'll vote no.
